description: SE Ranking is an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform providing tools for rank tracking, competitor analysis, keyword research, and website auditing.
auth_notes: The SE Ranking API uses an API key (access token) passed with requests to authenticate.
credential_notes: API access is available on higher-tier plans (Pro and Business) or via specialized API pricing packages requiring a paid subscription.
api_notes: The API covers rank tracking, keyword research, competitor research, website audits, and project management data.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by SE Ranking.
rationale: The API is fully documented and functional, but requires a paid subscription or specific API plan tier to obtain credentials.
